component.name: Obsidian PostIt
component.summary: Quick diary and sticky notes from the KDE tray into an Obsidian vault

description.p: Obsidian PostIt lives in the system tray and captures quick notes and a daily journal straight into an Obsidian Markdown vault — without launching Obsidian. A continuous Diary holds one rolling file per device; standalone Notes are individual Markdown files with filenames guessed from content. Tags, live syntax highlighting, search, autostart and optional OpenRouter AI (Summarize/Clean) are included; the API key is kept in the system keyring, never in a config file.
Initial release: Diary journal, sticky Notes, tags, search, autostart, and optional OpenRouter AI.
